data.description:
ADD EXPLICIT FILE PERMISSIONS AFTER ATOMIC WRITES

FILE: cortical/utils/persistence.py (around line 44)

PURPOSE: Ensure sensitive state files have restrictive permissions

IMPLEMENTATION:
Add os.chmod() call after atomic write completes:
```python
# After rename
path.chmod(0o600)  # Owner read/write only
```

Consider making permission configurable via parameter.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- New files created with 0o600 permissions
- Existing functionality unchanged
- Works on Linux/macOS (skip on Windows)

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Change atomic write behavior
- Break Windows compatibility (make it conditional)
- Add external dependencies

VERIFY: 
python -c "from cortical.utils.persistence import atomic_save; import tempfile; import os; f=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False); atomic_save(f.name, {'test': 1}); print(oct(os.stat(f.name).st_mode)[-3:])"
